records.part: CyberNational portable shooting trailer to collect firearms data outside of a laboratory setting
records.reason: CyberNational is the only vendor that provides a custom-built mobile shooting system that includes: a self-enclosed HEPA-filtered Retriev-All cartridge case retrieval system which is rated to capture cartridges up to 50 BMG caliber; filter obstruction gauges; Aluminum clad walls for efficient cleaning; industrial rubber floor; and a ballistic blanket.
